A [[Sentience|sentient]] '''species''' existed in [[the galaxy]]. They had [[Color|green]] or tan skin and black [[eye]]s. One member of the [[species]] was [[Gatha Elbaphay]], who was at [[Canto Bight]] in [[34 ABY]].

==Biology and appearance==
The species had [[Color|green]],<ref name="Grand Theft Falcon" /> orange,<ref name="Jabba the Hutt 1" /> or tan colored skin.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==Members in the galaxy==
When [[Gannis Ducain]], who stole the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' from [[Han Solo]], was present in [[Canto Bight]], a member of this species was also present there.<ref name="Grand Theft Falcon" />

During [[34 ABY]], a member of this species named [[Gatha Elbaphay]] was present in Canto Bight while [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] were searching for the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The species was created for the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, {{Film|VIII}}.<ref name="Episode VIII" /> According to [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]], no name was assigned to the species.<ref name="Pablo">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1466630796203094018|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Hah. I looked up K010's name, and it's Gatha Elbaphay (& her dog Awgree); which is derived from my goofy placeholder names of Ms Elbowface and Gary. No species name assigned to it.|archivedate=20211203083131 }}</ref>
